buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Pre-Qualification Criteria: 1a) Experience: Bidder has to submit atleast one purchase order copy of electronic comp onents within last 5 years from the date of enquiry.

1b) Relaxation of Norms for Start-ups: The condition of Prior Turnover and prior experi ence is relaxed for all start-ups whether Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) or otherwise subj ect to meeting of quality and technical specifications in accordance with the relevant provis ion of GFR,2005 and other DOE-PPD notifications for relaxation norms for start-ups issued f rom time to time. 2) Payment term: 100% basic payment shall be made within stipulated days as mentione d below from the date of receipt of all item, subject to the acceptance at BHEL Corporate R &D, Hyderabad, against submission of GST compliant Invoice. Type of bidder: A. For Micro & Small enterprises (MSEs) payment will be made within 45 days B. For Medium Enterprises will be made within 60 days C. Non MSMEs will be made within 90 days However, GST Portion of Invoice shall be released only upon: i) Vendor declaring the Invoice in their GSTR-1. ii) Receipt of Goods and Tax Invoice by BHEL. iii) Confirmation of Payment of GST thereon by vendor on GSTN. Note: “Payment Timelines” mentioned in the GeM Bid document shall be ignored and the Payment term shall be as per this clause. 3) Terms of Delivery: FOR BHEL R&D, Hyderabad. 4) Delivery Period: The delivery period shall be within 70 days from the date of order. Par t delivery before due date is acceptable. 5) Compliance on restrictions under Rule 144 (XI) of the GFR: Submit the Annexure - C which is attached in ATC document. 6) Compliance on Treatment of cases regarding conflict of interest: Submit the An nexure - D which is attached in ATC document. 7) Make In India (MII) certificate: Submit the Annexure - E which is attached in buyer ad ded bid specific ATC document. 8) Technical Specification: Bidder shall submit compliance on attached BHEL Technical s pecification uploaded in Buyer Specification Document (Annexure-B). 9) Details of Items: 1 set of quantity mentioned in the bid is for items stated in Annexure -F where the part numbers and quantity required against each part number are mentioned. Bidder to mention their offered part number in Bidder Remarks/Acceptance Column against BHEL requirement mentioned in Item Description column which is attached as Annexure-F i n Additional Scope of Work. 10) Price Bid and Un-Price Bid Format: a) Signed and stamped Un-Price bid format shall be submitted along with Technical Bid. Ple ase do not mention any price in this format except GST percentage (%). (Attached as Anne xure – A1 in Additional Scope of Work) b) Price bid format shall be submitted along with Financial Bid. (Attached as Annexure – A2 in Additional Scope of Work)

11) Signed GeM Bid document: Vendor has to submit this GeM bid document duly signe d and stamped on all pages. By submitting singed Gem bid document it affirms that vendor has accepted to all terms and conditions mentioned in this bid such as payment terms, deli very period, Terms of Delivery, Breach of contract, Remedies and Termination, Invoice regi stration and documents upload in SUVIDHA portal by suppliers, Invoice Settlement for MSM E Suppliers only through TReDS platforms authorised by the Reserve Bank of India etc. 12) Vendor has to quote price(s) inclusive of GST, Transportation/Insurance, Loading/Unloa ding charges. Insurance, loading/unloading from vendor site to BHEL R&D, Hyderabad will b e in vendor scope only. 13) Banned firms: The offers of the bidders who are under suspension as also the offers o f the bidders, who engage the services of the banned firms / principal / agents, shall be reje cted. The list of banned firms is available on BHEL web site https://www.bhel.com/supplier-r egistration 14) Breach of contract, Remedies and Termination: In case of breach of contract, wh erever the value of security instruments like performance bank guarantee available with B HEL against the said contract is atleast 10% of the contract value, the same be encashed. In case the value of the security instruments available is less than 10% of the contract valu e, the balance amount be recovered from other financial remedies (i.e. available bills of the contractor, retention amount, etc. with BHEL) or legal remedies be pursued. Further, levy o f liquidated damages, debarment, termination, de-scoping, short-closure, etc., shall be appl ied as per provisions of the contract. 15) Invoice registration and documents upload in SUVIDHA portal by suppliers : Ir respective of the value of the invoice amount, the bidder/vendor should necessarily upload the dispatch & invoice details on BHEL SUVIDHA portal at https://suvidha.bhel.in/suvidha/, p rior to dispatch. All documents as per PO checklist, along with additional documents (if any) , must be uploaded on the portal. It is mandatory that tax invoices with a net amount (inclu ding taxes) exceeding Rs five lakhs uploaded on the portal are digitally signed using a Clas s 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) issued by a licensed Certifying Authority. Submission of invoice document in hard copy is all owed for invoices with a net amount (including taxe s) equal to and upto Rs five lakhs, in case they were not digitally signed and uploaded on t he portal. The material will not be accepted inside BHE L in absence of the above. 16) Invoice Settlement for MSME Suppliers: “In respect of procurement of goods or services from Micro, Small and Medium enterprises (MSMEs), the settlement of invoice shall be only through TReDS platforms authorised by th e Reserve Bank of India. Presently BHEL Corp. R&D is registered with the following TReDS p latforms: RXIL, M1xchange and Invoicemart. Such MSME suppliers to select their preferred TReDS platform before award of contract. They also will have the option to change the TReDS platform from the drop-down menu on Suvidha portal of BHEL, at the time of invoice submission. The routing of invoices through the TReDS platform shall not be construed as mandating di scounting of such invoices and the MSME suppliers shall have the option to avail or not avai l financing or discounting of its receivables on the TReDS platform. In case discounting is not availed by MSME supplier on TReDS, the trade receivables will

be paid through TReDS as per the payment timelines indicated in the contract.” 17) BHEL GSTIN: 36AAACB4146P1ZG. 18) Following documents to be submitted by bidders along with offer: a. PAN Number b. GSTIN Registration copy c. Bank details d. Latest UDYAM Certificate (If applicable) 19) Grievance Redressal Mechanism: To promote transparency and ensure fair treatm ent of all bidders, a structured Grievance Redressal Mechanism is in place to address any c oncerns or issues arising during the tendering process or in subsequent business dealings with the company. Suppliers/Contractors are requested to follow the below escalation proce ss for grievance resolution: 1) First Level: Any grievance should initially be addressed to the designated Dealing Officer , whose contact details are provided in the Notice Inviting Tender (NIT)/Contract. 2) Second Level: If the issue remains unresolved, it may be escalated by lodging a formal g rievance through the SUVIDHA Portal: https://suvidha.bhel.in/suvidha/. Responses will be pr ovided in accordance with the defined escalation matrix.”. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
